title: Returning to Study After Years Away
paragraphs: At thirty-six, Ismail decides to finally finish the university degree he left unfinished more than a decade ago, feeling both excited and nervous about sitting in classrooms again after so long.
His classmates are mostly in their early twenties, and at first he feels somewhat out of place, worried they might view him as strange for restarting his studies so much later than usual.
During the second week, a younger classmate asks him for career advice during a group project, genuinely valuing his years of real workplace experience rather than seeing his age as something odd.
By the semester's end, Ismail realizes that his age brought a different, valuable kind of perspective to the classroom. He no longer feels out of place, only grateful he chose to return.
